I posted the draft in #strategic-random as a reply to your message. It's built only from the #inc-vtg-hartford log, which you're in. I haven't emailed it to Mateo's team.

- First report: 10:42 AM, Aug 3. Gate kiosks offline, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, when trailer 8836 was checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

The log gives times with no time zone, so confirm the zone before it goes out. The draft also notes that status-page access for Mateo's account was still open after the lanes recovered.
